text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Ines! You're full of energy today 
too~.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Ines, there's a favor I'd like 
to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of entrusting you with a new 
job starting today. You're always so 
diligent, so I really want to rely on you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back. You look happy, Ines. Did 
something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Actually, I was entrusted with a 
super important job today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It feels great knowing the manager relies 
on me so much~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Ines, you always give it 
your all, and that's why I think everyone 
relies on you so much!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Getting praised so directly makes 
me blush~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll do my best to live up to 
the manager's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Ines Fujin took on more 
demanding tasks, gaining all sorts of new 
insights along the way.
